source_scope: Six owner-selected private Stooq captures from draft #53; current-vintage unverified adjustments, no raw/public data or trained/deployed trading model.

features.volatility: Sample standard deviation of strictly prior daily returns; instrument-specific, not a universal return cutoff.
features.volume_baseline: Median of strictly previous 60 positive reported volumes; minimum 20. Missing volumes stay missing.
features.benchmark: Exact-date SPY close returns and prior active-return volatility. GLD descriptive ETF proxy only.

ranking.research_window: Three preceding reporting sessions through the move date; later sources recorded but cannot be precursor inputs.
ranking.selection: Price-first outcome-selected discovery; retain suspected actions/bad prints and unexplained or uninvestigated candidates, never invent a headline.

episodes.first_detection: First chronological trigger, not the later largest move.
episodes.independence: Overlapping windows/companies are not independent trials.

controls.price_controls: Non-trigger bars with similar strictly past volatility/trend in the preceding 126 reporting sessions. Select deterministic date/hash, not future returns. Retain missing outcomes; no retry for winners.
controls.issuer_controls: All four fiscal-quarter earnings releases for fiscal 2024 (NVDA fiscal 2025), for each of NVDA/AMD/MRNA/BMY, irrespective of price response. Small/no-move status is an outcome, never a selection filter.
controls.clinical_controls: FDA first approval announcements for Moderna mRESVIA and BMY Cobenfy in 2024, irrespective of price response; cannot substitute for earnings or safety-setback controls.

replay.classification: All historical scan/replay and 2020-2026 results are exploratory. The earlier 21-event holdout remains frozen and examined, not unseen.
replay.entry: First reporting-session close strictly after detection bar date; actual historical bar receipt is unknown. No pre-move fill.
replay.costs: All four unchanged SIM-1 cost assumptions; fixed no-trade and exact-window SPY-relative references.
replay.fitting: No threshold optimization, model fitting, rule/horizon winner selection or probabilities. Fixed rules compared chronologically and against controls.

future_evaluation.start: Only genuinely new observations/events first received after actual registration, locked before outcomes.
future_evaluation.deployment: No continuous financial-news service or push alerts are deployed. EVT-2 remains a pilot; bounded feed integration/prospective paper operation is a subsequent staged deliverable.
